text: SiteHeader takes `service` (`HeaderService`: name, optional mark and href). A `variant="portal"` masthead that passes it gets its phone layout below 768: the accessibility bar, then the department's Lockup 2 complete (Government of India, Ministry, Department, as DBIM 5.2.2 requires) with BETA as a 45° corner sash, then a 56px working bar (menu, emblem and service name, bell, account) that is the only row to pin. The upper rows leave by a negative sticky offset, not the condense morph. E-Anudaan is the first portal on it; tablet and desktop are unchanged. The single-row phone masthead keeps the Government of India line again and loses the outlined boxes on its controls; the accessibility bar keeps "Government of India" on one line on a phone
